page.title: Account Settings
page.subtitle: Manage your personal profile, security and preferences

nav.phase2Hint: Phase 2 — backend preference API not in MVP

common.apiPending: This action needs a backend API that is not shipped yet. UI is ready for when it is.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Your personal information. Visible to teammates across your workspaces.
profile.avatarPending: Avatar upload will be available when the profile API ships.
profile.avatarSizeError: Image size exceeds 2MB. Please choose a smaller file.
profile.avatarTypeError: Only JPG, PNG, or GIF files are supported.
profile.emailHelp: Email cannot be changed in this version. Contact support to update.
profile.saveLocal: Saved in this session only. Server profile update (PATCH /api/me) is not available yet.

security.title: Security
security.desc: Manage your password and connected accounts
security.passwordDesc: Change your password. Must be at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.
security.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
security.tipText: Avoid reusing passwords from other apps or easily guessable personal info.
security.oauthDesc: Sign in faster with social accounts. Disconnect anytime.
security.googleNotConnected: Sign in with Google for faster access
security.disconnectDesc: You will no longer be able to sign in with Google. You can reconnect later.
security.disconnectSuccess: Google disconnect API is not available yet.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.desc: Customize how TransFlow looks and behaves for you
prefs.langDesc: Interface language. Affects labels, buttons and messages.
prefs.densityDesc: How compact data tables appear (Data-Dense track not affected)
prefs.syncNote: Language and theme are stored in localStorage (tf-ui / tf-lang) and apply immediately. Phase 2 will sync to user profile via UserProfileApiProvider (09b §A.0).

ws.title: My Workspaces
ws.desc: Workspaces you belong to. Switch between them using the switcher in the top navigation or the buttons below.
ws.leaveDesc: You will lose access to all projects, documents and translations in this workspace. This action cannot be undone.
ws.leavePending: Leave-workspace API is not available yet.
ws.cannotLeaveLastAdmin: You cannot leave — you are the last Admin. Transfer ownership first.
ws.empty: You are not a member of any workspace yet.
ws.wsSettingsNote: Workspace-level settings (Members, AI Providers) are separate. Use the sidebar under System when you have Admin access — /w/:id/settings/members and /w/:id/settings/provider.

credit.balanceHelp: Credits are charged when AI and media processing stages run. Personal purchases are available to every workspace role.
credit.addDesc: Choose a package and record its payment reference. Online payment is not connected in this MVP.
credit.historyDesc: Every grant, purchase, usage charge and adjustment to your account.
credit.empty: No credit transactions match this filter.
credit.purchaseSuccess: Package purchased. Your new balance is {{balance}} credits.

modal.title: Choose a credit package
modal.desc: The selected amount is credited immediately after confirmation.
modal.noPackages: No credit packages are currently available.
modal.referenceHelp: Use the bank transfer or internal payment reference. A real payment gateway is not connected yet.
modal.error: The package could not be purchased. Check the reference and try again.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.desc: Permanently delete your account and all personal data. Workspaces you own will be transferred or deleted.
danger.warning: This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All your personal data, preferences and session history will be deleted.
deletedItems: Segments you have translated (anonymized, not removed)
keptItems: Workspaces you created (transferred to another Admin)
Translations contributed to shared Translation Memory
Glossaries and Projects owned by workspaces
danger.confirmDesc: Type DELETE to confirm. This will permanently delete your account.
danger.wrongText: Please type DELETE exactly to confirm
danger.pending: Account deletion API is not available yet. No data was deleted.
danger.gdprNote: If you want to export your personal data before deleting, contact support@transflow.io. A JSON export can be provided within 30 days (when the export API ships).
